overlap_analysis.same_reused_invariant: anti-replay idempotency (one award per unique submission) - REUSED as a concept from LN-05
what_is_genuinely_new: Threat model: an ACTIVE adversary who controls the delivery channel (can forge the server actor string, restart sessions, replay across devices), versus LN-05's honest-delivery policy-correctness model

Defense mechanisms LN-05 does not have: HMAC-SHA256 server-side reward attestation (attacker cannot mint actor='server' without the server key), persistent cross-session idempotency ledger (award identity survives session/device changes), velocity/burst gates
Evaluation boundary LN-05 explicitly never claimed: persistent state across predict_batch calls; P08 measures exactly that boundary
New metrics: attack-detection recall and per-attack-vector defense rates over 6 attack vectors x 500 deliveries, distinct from LN-05's family-classification accuracy
what_is_not_claimed: NO human-outcome evidence of any kind: no motivation, engagement, trust, completion, or learning-effect claims (human strata = BLOCKED; deceptive-copy stratum = NOT_APPLICABLE in this evaluation)
NO gamification-design science: the DiGRA RQ (trust/engagement/gaming behavior) cannot be estimated without users; P08 is a software-security/integrity paper or nothing
NO claim that LN-05 is wrong: LN-05 is correct within its stated boundary (single-batch policy correctness); P08 evaluates the boundary LN-05 never claimed

collision_check.primary_hypothesis_v2_ln05: The LN-05 5-gate policy classifies 120 synthetic policy cases into the correct gold decision family (family-classification accuracy; no active adversary, no persistent state, no human outcomes).
collision_check.primary_outcome_table_p08: per-attack-vector defense matrix: [attack-detection recall, false-award count, duplicate-award count, false-rejection count of honest traffic] x 6 attack vectors + idempotency proof (100x -> exactly 1 award), all from one frozen campaign run
collision_check.primary_outcome_table_v2_ln05: confusion matrix over 5 decision families on 120 labeled synthetic cases

decision_justification: P08 PROCEEDs as a SOFTWARE SECURITY evaluation because the empirical probes show LN-05 measurably fails three attack classes it never claimed to cover - cross-session replay (fresh ledger per predict_batch call grants a re-delivered award), forged server-actor attestation (actor='server' is client-supplied and accepted with forged evidence), and velocity farming (30/30 burst grants) - and P08's frozen hypothesis targets exactly those boundaries with defenses LN-05 lacks (HMAC attestation, persistent idempotency, velocity control). The reused part (the anti-replay invariant concept and honest-delivery sanity cases) is disclosed as reuse from LN-05; the primary outcome table (per-vector defense rates + idempotency proof under an active adversary) cannot be produced by switching LN-05's parameters (reviewer checklist item 7), because LN-05 has no attestation key, no persistent ledger, and no velocity gate to switch on. P08 is therefore not 'LN-05 under a new name': different threat model, different defense mechanisms, different estimand, different primary table. All human-outcome claims (trust, engagement, motivation, learning) are BLOCKED and will never be claimed; the paper, if it proceeds to manuscript, is framed as a security/integrity contribution with no human-subjects evidence.
